header.title: Why Fare Calculator?
header.subtitle: We created Fare Calculator to address an essential need: making urban transport more transparent, fair, and accessible to everyone.

content.title: The need behind the solution
content.description:
Today, users do not always know how much a trip costs. Whether you are a casual customer, a professional, or a company, it is crucial to estimate a fare accurately before accepting or offering a service.

Fare Calculator allows anonymous users to make some free estimates, while offering more possibilities to registered or professional accounts. It's a fast, efficient solution designed for all types of travelers or drivers.

header.title: Our Vision
header.subtitle: Building a future where every trip is predictable, fair, and connected through innovation.

content.title: A vision of fairness and technology
content.description:
Our vision is to make urban transport smart, transparent, and fair. Through Fare Calculator, we envision a world where every user can make informed decisions, plan trips with confidence, and avoid fare abuses.

We aim to become a benchmark for automated fare estimation, integrated with local and international platforms. A solution for sustainable, inclusive mobility, powered by data.

header.title: About Fare Calculator
header.subtitle: At Fare Calculator, we don’t just calculate fares. We help optimize trips, make mobility more accessible, and improve the transportation experience for everyone.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to simplify fare calculation for all types of users: anonymous, registered, or professional. By providing accurate, fast, and intelligent estimates, Fare Calculator contributes to smoother, more economical, and responsible urban mobility.

q1.question: How do I use the fare calculator?
q1.answer: Enter your starting point and destination, then click 'Calculate'. The system will estimate the cost based on the distance.

q2.question: Do I need an account to perform a calculation?
q2.answer: No, you can perform up to 3 calculations for free without creating an account.

q3.question: How do I create an account?
q3.answer: Click the 'Sign Up' button at the top of the calculation page and fill in the requested information.

q4.question: How can I view my calculation history?
q4.answer: Create an account, log in, and then access the 'History' tab.
